# Workflow 2 — Google Opening Discovery

**What it does:** This workflow takes the **Pending** searches from the `Search_Queue` tab and searches them on Google using SerpApi. It then saves the possible opening announcement links in the `Opening_Candidates` tab.

**Limits:** Each run can process up to **5 search queries**, and each query can return up to **10 organic results**. You can change these limits in the `Run_Config` tab.

**Important:** Google search results are only possible evidence. They do not confirm that a business is actually opening.

**Status:** If a search runs successfully, its status changes to `Completed`. If something goes wrong, it changes to `Error`. If no results are found, it still shows `Completed`, but the result count will be `0`.

## Start

This workflow starts manually. To test it, just click **Execute Workflow**.

## 1. Read Config and Data

First, open the **Config** node and paste your Google Sheet ID.

Then, select your Google account credentials in all Google Sheets nodes.

## 2. Get Pending Queries

This step picks the first **Pending** search queries from the `Search_Queue` tab. By default, it picks up to **5 queries**.

If there are no Pending queries, the workflow stops here.

## 3. Google Search and Results

This step searches Google UK using **SerpApi**.

If a search fails, the workflow will not stop. It will simply mark that query as `Error` and continue with the others.

It also removes duplicate URLs, so the same link will not be saved again if it already exists or appears more than once in the new results.

## 4. Save Candidates

Each new link is saved as a separate row in the `Opening_Candidates` tab with `Review_Status = New`.

The workflow first saves the candidates and then updates the query status.

If saving fails, the queries will stay as `Pending`, so they can be tried again later.

## 5. Update Status

This step updates each query with its status (`Completed` or `Error`), `Results_Count`, and `Last_Run`.

If a query fails and you want to run it again, just open the Google Sheet and change its status back to `Pending`.
